objective: Fix Clerk login access issue on massdwellhub.com

evidence.output_tail: Done. Here's what was broken and what changed:  **Root cause (two bugs):** 1. `sessionClaims?.email` is never populated — Clerk's default JWT doesn't include email, so Steve's bypass was always dead code 2. The original middleware (before this session) was blocking ALL users whose `role` wasn't `'admin'` or `'user'` — which is every new Google OAuth user → infinite redirect loop back to `/sign-in`  **Fix in `middleware.ts`:** - Removed the broken `sessionClaims?.email` / `isSteve` check -
